smaller: Gold / GC=F — A dovish Fed voice lifts gold's floor
GameStop / GME — The meme ETF closes as GameStop pops

why_lead: Newly published Standard Chartered 100K USD bitcoin call and 'crypto spring' framing (n0659, n0817) met the biggest crypto-equity moves on the 2023-11-28 session: MARA +9.75% (+39.89% over 20 sessions), Riot +8.80%, IREN +15.00%, Coinbase +7.10%, versus bitcoin +1.55% on the daily close. Simple repeatable story (miners as leverage to a bank target) with drivers (fee record n0791, renewables rehabilitation n0818, Dorsey mining-pool round n0819), attention/speculation evidence (n0783, n0300, n0920, n1511), the operating-leverage mechanism as analog, a bank-versus-regulator/critic split (n0824, n0586, n0363) and breaks at bitcoin's 35,655.28 USD 20-session reference, energy politics and ETF timing.
why_smaller: Gold: newly published dovish Fed signal (Waller, n1782) and worst-month dollar coverage (n1818) with gold +1.37% to 2,040.00 USD/oz, GDX +4.80% and Newmont +6.26%: the Fed-is-done haven trade; last week's slip below 2,000 USD (n1741) and consensus crowding (n1517) supply the break. Silver appeared on 2023-11-27 on a dollar story; this is a Fed-speaker catalyst on gold itself.

GameStop: +13.27% to 13.49 USD on the day Roundhill said it will shut its MEME ETF for flagging interest (n0738): meme defiance versus fading participation (AMC -32.73% over 20 sessions, n0567). Last meme-stock item was AMC on 2023-11-10.

Berkshire Hathaway: material update of the 2023-11-27 item on newly published news of Charlie Munger's death (n0769) and tribute coverage (n0634, n0698); lagging-tech and Munger-mistakes framing (n0699, n0670) supply the succession break.
